AI stock volatility and retirement savings concerns

Recent volatility in Artificial Intelligence (AI) stocks has raised concerns for retirement savers regarding their 401(k) investments. While AI stocks have experienced significant swings, their impact on long-term retirement funds is a key consideration. Additionally, discussions around private market assets in 401(k) plans are ongoing, with potential regulatory changes aiming to provide clearer legal guidance for fiduciaries evaluating such investments. The Labor Department has proposed a safe harbor that could offer this clearer footing.
